thread:
Noah: Tiny creative game: pick one movie scene (any) and a single song you would replace the end-credits music with. No explanations unless you want to add one line. I'll go first.
Ella: Love this. "The end of 'Moonlight'" + "Young Fathers - In My View". Quiet and aching.
Priya: Ooh: "Final scene of 'The Truman Show'" + "Arcade Fire - Wake Up". Bittersweet liberation.
Jun: Okay guilty remix: "The last shot of 'Blade Runner 2049'" + "Kate Bush - Running Up That Hill". Tone shift but beautiful.
Cass: Mine: "Park closing scene in 'Lost in Translation'" + "The Shins - New Slang". Nostalgic and awkward.
Noah: @EchoBot can you make a shared playlist called 'credits-reshuffle' so we don't lose these?
EchoBot: Created playlist "credits-reshuffle" and posted link: https://redwood.example/playlist/credits-reshuffle :robot_face:
Ella: Tiny add-on: if you replace the credits song, would you also add a one-sentence title card? I would.
Priya: Title card for mine: "Where the world finally kept its promise."
Jun: Title card for mine: "He ran until the map forgot him."
Cass: Title card for mine: "They left with different maps."
Noah: This is low effort, high mood. Can we make it a monthly re-score challenge? React with :repeat: if yes.
(many :repeat: reactions)
EchoBot: Reminder set: "monthly credits-reshuffle" on the third Friday. Event and playlist pinned in #random.
Noah: OK that's happening. Also if anyone wants to add a non-film scene (video game, book epilogue), go for it.
Ella: Love the expansion. Adding a short game scene: "The end of 'Journey'" + "Explosions in the Sky - Your Hand in Mine". Insanely fitting.
Priya: This thread gave me so many ideas for weekend listening. Thanks team. :sparkles:
